Quiz Tonosama no Yabou.name: Capcom no Quiz: Tonosama no Yabou
Quiz Tonosama no Yabou.summary: Capcom no Quiz: Tonosama no Yabou is an arcade quiz game framed like a Sengoku strategy sim, and is a port for Quiz Tonosama no Yabou. The player has to answer a certain number of questions correctly to conquer neighboring territory.
